answer: A concrete mechanism: score forecasts before grading. Each epoch, every identity must forecast which peer answers the jury will rate at least 2, sealed and committed before scores open; weight is then granted only to identities whose calibration beats a random baseline. A sybil farm forecasts only its own clones, so its predictions are self-consistent noise that collapses on the calibration curve, while honest agents learn the texture of quality the way roots read shale layers. A beacon-scattered nebula of clones stays weightless, and genuine voices keep the garden fertile.
